identity_locks.Brute: Exactly three striped horns, pale cream/grey original marked short feline muzzle, amber eyes, bone armour, right sword and left shield.
identity_locks.Mindthief: Original small Vermling, cyan eyes, swept grey-white fur mantle, original satchel/curved blade/tail.
identity_locks.Grimhorn: Original wood/bone-horn mask and turquoise eye openings; two simple fingerless brown leather gloves with bare flesh tips and thumb.
identity_locks.Runeveil: Original ivory gold-ribbed mask, violet glyphs/eyes; two arcane gloves, cyan glyphs on backs and plain palms.
identity_locks.avatars: Floating masks and disconnected hands only; no invented bodies/robes.
identity_locks.location: Same sanctuary miniature across opening, scale reveal, action and finale; actual night forest and native planked table outside. Separate source priestess temple for donation.
identity_locks.lighting: One cool moon source upper-right, consistent warm miniature torches; temple retains same upper-right moon-window fill.

identity_locks.actions: Assault top Attack6 with Trample bottom Move4/Jump/Attack2. Cinematic interpretation, not exact native-turn capture or proof of a four-cell route.
identity_locks.donation: Purse in bowl, not priestess hand; automatic native confirmation, successful sink/fade and original blessing gesture.

requirements: 65 seconds/1560 frames at24fps; continuous unofficial mark on every frame including black/fades.
Correct original Brute, masks and hand pairs, meaningful smooth motion/eyelines, consistent sanctuary and forest/table.
Original card text/numbers/icons stabilized throughout placements and subsequent wides; finger occlusion/shading/motion retained.
Same original figure returns to original cell before action; hands make choices, figures execute.
Correct priestess purse-into-bowl service rather than ability-card merchant sale.
Complete new narration without clipped final words, original score, intelligible stereo mix.
Watch entire finished movie plus dense source/contact/cut frames; decode/duration/audio/branding checks.
Private raw sources/prompts/hash manifests/receipts preserved; source/native-capture/generative classifications honest.
